summary: The candidate's narrow source change is verified and retained: it reuses source IR already serialized for CompiledArtifact and avoids a second get_asm call before the required parse copy. The base rejects the retained-source argument and the candidate regression passes. Identical cache, source-IR, and compiled-IR hashes plus independent Torch GPU references establish unchanged compilation identity and correctness. Independent fresh-cache observations do not demonstrate an end-to-end speedup, and no evidence justified a broader speculative compiler change, so this correction changes the claim from a full fix to a verified partial optimization.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior: base MlirCompiler.compile has no source_ir parameter and raises TypeError when it is supplied.
Base fresh-cache RMSNorm cold call 145.40 ms and compiler pipeline 82.65 ms; GPU output matched Torch with max absolute error 0.0009765625.
Base fresh-cache GEMM cold call 714.05 ms and compiler pipeline 229.50 ms; GPU output matched Torch within the maintained tolerance with max absolute error 0.4954681396484375.
Passing-after regression and cache identity/completeness coverage; 20 tests passed.
Candidate fresh-cache RMSNorm cold call 149.69 ms and compiler pipeline 83.96 ms; hashes and numerical error match base.
Candidate fresh-cache GEMM cold call 750.16 ms and compiler pipeline 225.69 ms; hashes and numerical error match base.
The issue-linked external RMSNorm dependency remains incompatible because flydsl.expr.vector is absent.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) executed base and candidate RMSNorm and GEMM against independent Torch references; raw logs retain cache identities, IR hashes, and errors.
remaining_limitations: The candidate is a structural reduction of duplicate work; isolated cold wall-clock observations were slower and are not evidence of an end-to-end speedup.

Most measured compiler-pipeline time remains: about 84 ms for maintained RMSNorm and 226 ms for maintained GEMM after the change. No additional avoidable duplicate path was established within the approved investigation.
The exact issue-linked external RMSNorm workload remains unverified because it imports the removed flydsl.expr.vector API. Missing compatibility is not used to justify a source change.
The reported MI355 was unavailable. Validation used the assigned MI350X, which shares gfx950 but is not identical hardware.
No native rebuild was needed because the retained correction changes Python orchestration only.
